summary: BUG-0048: the background ISO upload is a row inside Recent tasks instead of a panel stacked above it; managed_vm_browser asserts the row and disambiguates the Network combobox from the MTU field.

guide.reason: The guide already says progress, rate and Cancel appear under Recent tasks; this change makes the UI match that wording.

api.reason: Presentation of the existing browser-to-Controller upload state only; no request, response or agent command changes.

state.reason: Transient in-browser upload progress; the durable iso-import task stays on the pool master.

verification.method: npm run typecheck and build pass. managed_vm_browser.py --simulated on the workstation passed the new upload-row assertions and captured browser-simulated-iso-upload-row.png (upload as first Recent tasks row); the run later failed on the uncommitted toolbar's ambiguous Back button, outside this change.
